text:
sara: Hey team — multiple pages just fired for payment-worker errors but nobody oncall got a phone ring. inc-bot posted 'page queued' and then silence. Customers seeing 30s-2min latency spikes. Anyone seeing the same?

mike: I can confirm. inc-bot webhooks to pagerflow are returning 5xx. quick scan shows repeated 502/500.

raj: pulling pager-proxy logs now. saw a deploy hook event at 11:02 UTC that touched inc-bot routing. grabbing full logs...

inc-bot: [system] alert created: alert_id=ALRT-20260318-8532, status=triggered, routed_to=pagerflow (queued) :rotating_light:

emily: @oncall-alex — did your phone ring at all?

oncall-alex: nothing. I only saw the DM in #incidents from inc-bot (no phone call, no SMS). checked Pager history — POST to /webhook returned 502 repeatedly.

mike: paste of pager-proxy error snippet:
```
2026-03-18T11:03:12Z ERROR webhook_proxy.go:214 POST https://pagerflow.company/api/v1/push 502 Bad Gateway response
http: server gave HTTP response to HTTPS client
```

raj: that "server gave HTTP response to HTTPS client" smells like TLS/endpoint mismatch — maybe the deploy hook flipped an endpoint URL to plaintext. Looking at the last deploy change: inc-bot 2026-03-18T11:02:05, commit b1c9f3 — changeset touched pager endpoint config.

ops-bot: [automation] recent deploy detected: inc-bot v2.14.0 -> v2.15.0 by @raj (deploy-id=deploy-8793). Notifying owners.

sara: Customer impact — two clusters (eu-prod and us-east-payments) reported elevated error rates and delayed tx processing. Support ticket #SUP-12345 opened, I posted a brief status.

emily: mitigation idea: switch incident routing to backup pager endpoint `https://pagerflow-backup.internal/api/v1/push` and force HTTPS. Can someone update the routing table?

mike: doing a quick curl test against backup: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST https://pagerflow-backup.internal/api/v1/push -d '{"test":true}'` returned 200. I'll update inc-bot runtime config and reload.

raj: updated config map on the running inc-bot instances, reloaded config. sending a test page now.

oncall-alex: got the test page. phone rung, SMS came through. :thumbsup:

sara: great, support informed. need a hotfix to restore primary endpoint and revert the bad config change in the deploy hook. Also add a canary test for webhook TLS on future deploys.

mike: PR opened to validate webhook URLs at startup and fail-safe to backup if mismatch: PR #432. Planning rolling restart of inc-bot replicas in 10m.

emily: please add an alert for pager webhook 5xx rate and for 'no-phone-rings' detection (i.e., queued pages without delivery events >30s).

sara: filed alert `pager-webhook-5xx-rate` and `incbot-missed-delivery-window`. Linking to this thread and the support ticket.

inc-bot: [automation] suppressing duplicate pages for alert ALRT-20260318-8532 for 30s while mitigation proceeds.

oncall-alex: reassigning follow-ups to SRE rotation. marking customer-notified :white_check_mark:. Keep me posted on the hotfix timeline.

mike: hotfix rolling, first replica restarted. monitoring delivery. will update when all replicas done.

sara: thanks. once stable we should do a short retro: root cause, why deploy allowed plaintext URL change, test gaps, and next actions (hotfix + deploy-gate).

emily: agreed. I'll create the retro doc and invite SRE + devs who authored the change.

raj: adding note to incident log: root suspected = deploy-hook config override of pager endpoint with wrong scheme; mitigation = route to backup + validate config at startup.

sara: closing active triage for now — follow-ups tracked in the retro.
